name: Adaptive Undersampling
aliases: Two-pass Adaptive Undersampling with Pre-computed Intervals
definition: A two-pass rendering method that accelerates volume integral calculation by pre-computing integral values over M equal intervals for a subset of pixels (one per n×n block) and storing them in a G-buffer. On the second pass, pixels use bilinear interpolation of these interval values for speed, or calculate integrals only over specific intervals if interpolation accuracy is insufficient, rather than integrating over the entire ray.
